description: Eclipse Proof is the governance + evidence line for agent video editing. Agents assemble timelines freely (T1), but export executes only against a Herald-signed approval pinning the canonical edit-decision fingerprint (integer-frame canonical JSON, RESOLVE_COV_V1), preset hash, principal and expiry; post-approval drift refuses TIMELINE_CHANGED_SINCE_APPROVAL with a localized DriftReport naming the caption track. Templates are hash-pinned signed artifacts filled by slots only. Every adapter mutation is read-back-verified because the Resolve API fails silently (ADAPTER_MUTATION_UNVERIFIED + automatic Friction finding). Proof Print (separate tool) verifies renders against the approved record — caption text verbatim, duration, loudness, format — into a VerificationPack; Proof Trace (separate tool, detective-only) fingerprints FCPXML. No code-exec tool exists on any surface. P0 ships with a simulated Resolve-shaped adapter: no Studio license exists on the build VM, so no live-Resolve claim is made.
